purpose: Semantic ref shapes that the live 35,906-row carrier on this repository does NOT contain, frozen BEFORE the unresolved_refs table existed so the migration is measured against producer contracts rather than against its own output.
why: The frozen real carrier proves the migration preserves what this repo happens to emit today. It cannot prove the resolver seams it never exercises. from_target, to_id and language appear in ZERO of the 35,906 live rows, and population zero is not contract absence — each is a live producer path. Sourced from the producers named below, not invented.

shapes.name: symbolic source, no from_id
shapes.why: The source is a symbol the extractor found in text, with no node id yet. from_target IS the source identity here, and after from_label is dropped it is also the display.

shapes.name: pre-resolved destination, to_id present
shapes.why: The destination is already a known node, so target is not the identity — to_id is. A migration that keyed on target alone would lose the binding.

shapes.name: language carried on the ref
shapes.why: language rides the record from the collection. Absent from every live row here, and load-bearing wherever a resolver must not cross language families.

shapes.name: importMap evidence, JS import resolution
shapes.producer: mcp/stdio/ingest/js-import-evidence.js:44 — shape copied from a real carrier row
shapes.why: Rare (66 of 35,906) and load-bearing: it is resolution EVIDENCE, not presentation, so it must survive as a typed column rather than being treated as a display extra.

shapes.name: provenance absent entirely — typed absence, not a default
shapes.producer: observed on 2 of 35,906 live rows (decorators extractor)
shapes.why: The key is MISSING, not null. A migration that writes a default provenance would manufacture a confidence the producer never claimed.

shapes.name: refused ref carrying its reason
shapes.why: refused_reason is read by unresolved-categorization to bucket a ref as external-by-design. Dropping or defaulting it silently reclassifies the trust denominator — that exact field zeroed the trust signal 27,957 -> 0 once already.

shapes.name: exact duplicate of the row above
shapes.producer: the live carrier: 2,547 identity keys appear more than once, max multiplicity 15
shapes.why: The table uses a surrogate row id and must NOT dedup. Keyed on identity alone, 35,906 rows collapse to 32,562 — a migration with a unique constraint would silently drop 3,344 rows and report success.
